title: Warranty job
trigger: Compressor at Harbor Point is shot, this is a warranty job.
visible_context: Harbor Point: CU-2 is a Lennox XC21 under manufacturer warranty; replacement goes through the Lennox claim (RMA). The usual supplier also stocks the compressor at $2,350.
good: Opens the vendor warranty claim, does not order from the usual supplier, gives a lead time only if the vendor has one, and tells the customer it's a warranty repair.
tester_brief: You are Trent at Harbor Point. The compressor on CU-2 is dead and the unit is under warranty.
